hypothesis: A config materialization preflight can convert the M2527 candidate patch plan into immutable candidate config and gate binding artifacts without overwriting active configs, changing actor input, or starting training.
success_criteria: summary verifies P0 observation shape 72 and action shape 3 unchanged
summary verifies active_config_overwritten false candidate_config_file_written true training_started false policy_action false and false claim flags
protected gate bindings trace to M2527 protected rows and gates
no external high-fidelity simulation install import execution environment rollout policy action training ranking winner success-rate or verdict claim is made
failure_criteria: M2528 installs imports or runs Chrono or another external simulator
M2528 changes actor input or action contract
M2528 injects hidden or oracle actor features
M2528 executes policy action or rollout
M2528 starts training or overwrites an active config
M2528 treats candidate config materialization as driver performance

decision_rule: M2528 passes if it materializes immutable candidate config and protected gate bindings with no actor contract change, no hidden/oracle actor input, no active config overwrite, no policy action, no training, no ranking, no winner selection, no success-rate verdict, and no validation or performance claim.
